description.en:
Chapter transition with the story chart: it fades both screens to black if the top screen is not already black (EV_FADE_SLOW), changes the sub-phase without effect (SetGameSubPhase(_subPhase, false)), shows the story chart (ShowStoryChart), swaps the top screen's brightness display (CMND_BRIGHT_SWAP(SCREEN_A, true, true)) and presents the new objective with PurposeEffect("J_10", _bgm_fade_off).
If _isMapJump is false and the screen was at normal brightness at the start, it fades back in; otherwise the screens stay dark, for the map jump or fade that follows.
true when a map jump follows (the screen stays dark).
Passed to PurposeEffect: true leaves the map BGM stopped.

examples.case: Followed by a fade-in (real usage, from ev42010500.nut)
